insufficiency_statement: Existing task selection can continue known work but cannot originate and govern a previously unavailable future state.

candidates.description: Create a prospective-admissibility receipt that separates origination from execution authority.
candidates.novelty_basis: No existing StegCore artifact defines a durable choice-space construction receipt with explicit refusal support.
candidates.expected_advance: StegCore can preserve newly generated possibilities without treating imagination as authorization to execute.

basis: Candidate generation is permitted; realization requires an existing governed execution authority.

consequence_assessment: Adds a new pre-execution governance record without changing deployed runtime behavior.

decision.reason: The candidate establishes the missing durable boundary while preserving explicit human and governed execution controls.

realization_boundary: This receipt authorizes specification and validation only; it does not authorize deployment or irreversible action.
